text: Command post offline. Teams keep going.
Access. Link lost. Working from what we know.
Facilities. No signal. We keep working.
Supply. Network's down. Using our own list.
Medics. Only Access in range now.
Supply. Lost contact with Access and Medics.
Access. We can't reach Supply. Holding the chair.
Facilities. The chair isn't ours to promise. Declined.
Medics. Refused. The chair is already spoken for.
Supply. Courier's on the way with the update.
Access. Courier's here. Scanning the update.
Supply. Update received, rerouting via west gate.
Medics. Link restored. Sharing our log.
Medics. First aid done at the north gate.
